paragraphs: R. Levi Sukhayya. R. Shimon, in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Yom HaKippurim, halakhah 6. Perhaps he is Sava, the Elder. In HaMotze Tefillin, Resh Lakish speaks in his name; the explanation is that Levi Sukhya is his name. Perhaps in Yom HaKippurim, R. Shimon speaking in his name means R. Shimon ben Lakish; if so, he may be Levi the Elder, in whose name Resh Lakish spoke.
